unsupported.label: Hasbro Pulse
unsupported.reason: The storefront is a client rendered single page app, so product listings do not exist in the HTML that is served. The data behind it is a private commerce API, not a public feed.

unsupported.label: NECA
unsupported.reason: necaonline.com/robots.txt disallows /products/ and /productlist/ for every crawler, which is where the listings live.

unsupported.label: McFarlane Toys
unsupported.reason: The site is a marketing showcase with no server rendered product data, no prices, and no working sitemap. There is nothing to read.

unsupported.label: Sideshow and Hot Toys
unsupported.reason: Every request is redirected into a virtual waiting room queue before any page is served. Working around that would mean evading a system built to control traffic.

unsupported.label: MAFEX and Medicom
unsupported.reason: The Medicom store publishes no product sitemap and its product endpoint returns nothing, so there is no listing to read.
